'''Tibrin Exotic Armaments''' was a company specializing in a variety of weaponry. The corporation was based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]] and was run by the native [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]]. In [[Tibranese]], the company was known as '''Tibrin Kish'nol'''.
